issues.finding: The two optional matrix arguments of the displayed existential quantifiers close immediately after the last g-conjunct, leaving the A_f conjunct outside their scope and making the conjunction malformed.
issues.proposed_resolution: Move the two closing brackets after the A_f conjunct, so all intermediate witnesses and the final function formula lie in the quantified conjunction.

translation_treatment: The Javanese target corrects only the placement of two closing brackets in the composition display. A bounded comparison view records the exact math change; frozen English bytes remain unchanged.
